name: EPIC 201553833
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 15.2 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201553833 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 15.201308 (16th-84th percentiles 14.818781-15.800354), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,160 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.88 solar masses and 15.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,370 K at its surface.
